findings_and_questions.first_contract: The door compiler builds an ID-keyed map, selects the first resolvable closure reference, and reports MissingClosure only when none resolve. It neither rejects duplicate solid IDs nor verifies that the selected solid has the expected owner or role. The public serializable plan, opening, and solid fields admit separately valid references and solids; absent or misdirected members can therefore select another existing solid if such a plan reaches the compiler. The returned source, centre and dimensions then come from that solid. The server source consumes the returned pose and sizes, without a claimed runtime incident.
findings_and_questions.condition: A malformed or independently modified plan must reach this public compiler, or the valid multi-layer producer contract must permit a first resolvable non-door leaf. No inspected source proves that ordinary generated plans violate their reference invariants, and missing earlier entries may be intended optional layers.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Establish closure-layer ordering, membership, uniqueness and ownership policy with the actual generator and all plan-admission boundaries. If this contract requires a specific leaf, retain or validate the exact typed relationship before interpreting geometry; preserve source-specific errors and intentional optional layers.
relationships: Related to /root/mhr_character prior P16-COLLISION-SELECTED-IDENTITY-LOSS: static compiler filters missing references, whereas this compiler finds the first existing closure. Different outputs and possible policies; central adjudication owns any alias.

findings_and_questions.first_contract: The public window leaf function accepts checked CuboidDimensions and turns width or height divided by 0.19 into usize board/came counts, then iterates those counts without a budget. CuboidDimensions accepts any finite nonnegative component, and its SignedLength leaf is finite-only. A finite component near f32::MAX is admissible; division can become infinity and a Rust float-to-integer cast saturates to usize::MAX, leaving a correspondingly enormous loop. The loop does not inspect the builder’s latched error; into_meshes returns that error only after the producer completes the loops. Work, allocation failure or termination could occur first. This is mathematical source analysis, not a runtime observation.
findings_and_questions.condition: A caller supplies an extremely large admitted dimension to compile_window_leaf; ordinary authored/generated dimensions and operational threat reachability were not established. Cast limits depend on target usize width; no exact measured work/time or guarantee of complete loop is claimed.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Decide who bounds dimensions or per-leaf geometry work, preserve the established zero-dimension and leaf-kind behavior, check derived count/work before iteration, and propagate a typed error without leaving excessive work behind. Do not weaken the general finite nonnegative CuboidDimensions owner if other consumers need its range.
relationships: 059 Q-L12-3cb18f41744872c3c239 left this exact producer/native caller untraced; Q-L12-f238115d43d2e895f929 tracks connected closure consumer. Neither record is current source validation.

findings_and_questions.first_contract: gate_sweep computes the number of samples by ceil(abs(angle)/step), divides by that count, iterates 0..steps and returns true after the loop. A zero angle implies no loop iterations, so this alone does not establish a closed-pose overlap check. The traced clearance producer calls CityGate::door, which uses hinge sign times a fixed π/2 angle.
findings_and_questions.condition: A different caller feeding a zero-angle DoorSpec to the sweep has not been established; neither does this prove all positive-angle geometry/sampling conditions or other consumers.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Preserve historical Q-L12-a43cb797f3b4bad3cfea and Q-L12-38f36a0615075b52560c pending the actual full sweep and admission policy across all callers; avoid asserting a zero-angle defect in the ordinary traced CityGate path.
relationships: Bounded current refinement of 059 gate-angle questions, not a whole-family closure or historical finding rewrite.
